marks.gloss_en: קל וחומר: על אבר ממנה חייב, על כולה לא כל שכן -- liable for eating a limb of the living bird, all the more for eating all of it
תא שמע: a bird lacking an olive-bulk -- Rebbi exempts, R' Elazar b'R' Shimon obligates; they dispute only over 'stands into limbs', so at any rate all agree an olive-bulk is not required (102b.4)
one who took a bird that has not an olive-bulk and ate it -- Rebbi exempts
הכא נמי במשהו בשר גידים ועצמות -- here too, a bit of meat, sinews and bones
Rav: one who ate a kosher bird alive -- [liable] for any amount
אמר רב נחמן: במשהו בשר, גידים ועצמות (= p_rn_mashehu_basar)
at any rate, all agree we do not require an olive-bulk

ומי איכא מידי דבכוליה לית ביה כזית בשר, ובחד אבר אית כזית במשהו בשר גידין ועצמות? -- is there a bird whose whole has not an olive-bulk of meat, yet one limb has an olive-bulk with a bit of meat, sinews and bones?
אין, בקלניתא (= p_sherevya_kelanita)
Rav Sherevya: yes -- the kelanita
אלא כעין קלניתא -- [a bird] like the kelanita (= p_kein_kelanita)
אימא סיפא: strangled -- all agree, an olive-bulk; but the kelanita is a non-kosher bird, and Rav said a non-kosher one, alive or dead, is for any amount!
rather, [a bird] like the kelanita
ומי איכא מידי דאילו אכיל ליה אחר לא מיחייב, ואכיל ליה האי מיחייב? -- is there a thing that another who eats it is not liable, and this one is?
זה לפי מחשבתו וזה לפי מחשבתו -- each according to his thought
ומי איכא מידי דאילו אכיל ליה אחר מיחייב, ואכיל ליה האי פטור? -- is there a thing that another who eats it is liable, and this one is exempt?
זה לפי מחשבתו וזה לפי מחשבתו
they dispute only in that one master holds: in its lifetime it stands [to be divided] into limbs, and one master holds: in its lifetime it does not stand into limbs
Rava: if you say Rebbi holds that thought concerning food is [significant] thought -- if he intended to eat it limb by limb and ate it whole, he is liable
Rava: if you say R' Elazar b'R' Shimon holds that thought concerning food is thought -- if he intended to eat it dead and ate it alive, he is exempt
'you shall not eat the life with the flesh' -- this is a limb from a living animal
Reish Lakish: 'you shall not eat the life with the flesh' -- this is a limb from a living animal and [also] flesh from a living animal
one who ate a limb from a living animal and flesh from a living animal -- per R' Yochanan, liable twice
